title: U.S. awards Samsung up to $4.745B CHIPS grant

sources.quote: The U.S. Department of Commerce awarded Samsung Austin Semiconductor, LLC, a subsidiary of Samsung Electronics (Samsung), up to $4.745 billion in direct funding under the CHIPS and Science Act to strengthen the resilience of the U.S. semiconductor supply chain, advance U.S. technology leadership, and fuel U.S. global competitiveness.

explain: The government agreed to give Samsung grants of up to $4.745 billion for new chip factories in Taylor, Texas and an expansion in Austin, paid as milestones are met.
